title: Spider Infestation
description: The miners at Cutter's Claim walked off eight days ago and will not go back down for any wage. Foreman Alsett says spiders thick enough to web a cart axle. Clear it.

objectives.description: Clear the giant spiders out of Cutter's Claim

notes: Threat: Cutter's Claim mine idle for eight days, miners refusing even a wage advance to go back down. Giver motive: Foreman Alsett and the Guild lose more to idle wages than to a bounty. Refusal: the claim stays empty and the idle-wage cost keeps climbing.
